about: C6. Single source for every tile label, unit, badge, disclaimer, the flag rule, the protocol line and the banned wording. Read by the web UI, the docs/wording lint (tests/repo) and the AI checker (api/app/ai/contract.py). Galit reviews this file in M1. Change it only through S0, as a contract commit.
status_line: Research prototype on public, de-identified data. Not a medical device. Not for clinical use or diagnosis.

headline_statement: Estimates how much stiffness the vertebra lost since an earlier scan, and how much of that the lesion accounts for. Adapted from CT rigidity analysis; not validated.

tiles.label: {level} stiffness change since Day {day_a}: {x}% (range {a}–{b}%) · the new lesion accounts for {y} points
tiles.sub_label: Adapted from CTRA; the published method compares with the other side in the same scan. Vertebral body, mean of central slices. Not validated.
tiles.pending_label: {level} stiffness change since Day {day_a}: pending FE ({available_in})

tiles.label: Same period, whole spine: T11–L5 ladder
tiles.sub_label: Diffuse bone loss across the spine, measured the same way

tiles.label: Stiffness change from AI mask {ai}% · from expert mask {expert}%
tiles.sub_label: AI vertebra masks agreed with radiologist-corrected masks: Dice 0.95, 6 vertebrae, 1 scan

tiles.label: Compressive strain in the lesion region: {ratio}× Day {day_a} (simulation)
tiles.sub_label: Linear FE, 800 N axial on the vertebral body; unvalidated

tiles.label: Lesion volume
tiles.sub_label: Phantomless calibration, adapted; unvalidated on spine

tiles.label: Estimated modulus, lesion vs reference (GPa), weak-bone / void
tiles.sub_label: Phantomless calibration, adapted; unvalidated on spine

tiles.label: Rigidity loss vs the other femur: {value}%

viewer.segmentation_badge: outlines: dataset radiologist-corrected masks · Bone Finder in M5
viewer.heatmap_caption: The heat map is simulated compressive strain under a load. It shows where the bone works hardest, not a prediction.
viewer.timeline_legend: Illustrative growth simulated from real scans A and B, not patient data

calibration.label: phantomless, adapted from a leg-region method (Eggermont 2019), unvalidated on spine

rule.compare: the two latest real scans of the patient
rule.lesion_new_or_grew: lesion volume at the level is new (0 on the earlier scan) or grew by at least growth_pct_min
rule.defaults_status: growth_pct_min (G) and lesion_share_pts_min (S) are set by the care team; Galit proposes defaults after R1. While either is null the flag cannot fire and reads pending.

templates.flagged: Flagged because: {change} at {level} ({vol_a} → {vol_b} cm³) and it accounts for {share} points of {level}'s stiffness loss.
templates.pending: Not yet evaluated: {change} at {level} ({vol_a} → {vol_b} cm³); its share of {level}'s stiffness change is pending FE ({available_in}).

flag.protocol_line: Review at the next huddle; confirm the mobility and fall-precaution plan; notify the attending physician, per your facility's protocol.

ai.footer: Computed from public, de-identified research data. For review by the care team. Research prototype, not for clinical use.
ai.patient_review_note: A clinician reviews this text before it is shared.

care_team_summary_lesion_only.headline: {level} lesion volume went from {vol_a} cm³ on Day {day_a} to {vol_b} cm³ on Day {day_b}.
care_team_summary_lesion_only.detail: The lesion is {pct_vert}% of the vertebra on Day {day_b}. The stiffness change and the lesion's share of it are pending the stiffness analysis.

patient_explanation_lesion_only.headline: On your Day {day_b} scan, the marked area in {level} measures {vol_b} cm³.
patient_explanation_lesion_only.detail: On your Day {day_a} scan it measured {vol_a} cm³. {level} is a bone in your spine. Your care team will talk with you about what this means.

suggested_questions: How has L1 changed since the first scan?
How did the other levels change?
Which points on the chart are simulated?
What does the heat map show?
copilot.refusal: This assistant restates the stored measurements. Diagnosis and treatment decisions belong to the care team.

template_answers.l1_change_lesion_only: L1 lesion volume: {vol_a} cm³ on Day {day_a} and {vol_b} cm³ on Day {day_b}. Both points are from real scans.

wording.about: The lint reads every banned_claims pattern case-insensitively (Python re) and runs over README.md, ARCHITECTURE.md, labels.json and the web text. It skips this `wording` object and ai.blocked_output_patterns / ai.number_words, which quote the banned words on purpose.
